h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gandhinagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gandhinagar

items.pText: Gandhinagar is a planned capital, laid out in numbered sectors with wide roads and a lot of tree cover. Many play areas here sit inside sector gardens, government housing and institutional campuses, with mature trees already in place. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 430 km away, and delivers it by road.

Trees give welcome shade in Gandhinagar's hot summers, but they also limit where equipment can go. Roots spread under the ground, branches overhang play zones and leaves block drains. We plan the layout around the trees you want to keep, using your photos and a rough site plan. Newer high-rise projects towards GIFT City bring a different kind of site, with podium gardens and compact spaces, and we plan those too.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Working around trees in a sector garden

c: Keep posts and foundations clear of large roots, since cutting them can harm the tree and roots lift the ground over time. Check that no branch hangs low over a slide exit or a swing arc. Leaves and seed pods fall on decks and rubber flooring, so plan a sweeping routine, especially before the monsoon. A tree trunk should never sit inside a safe play area, however attractive it looks on the drawing.

items.q: Can you plan a playground around existing trees?
items.a: Yes. Mark the trees on your site photos or plan, and we will place the equipment so that trunks, roots and low branches stay outside each safe play area.

items.q: Do you work with architects on campus projects?
items.a: Yes. We share layout drawings and installation details with your architect or garden designer, so the play area fits into the wider design of the campus.

items.q: How far is Gandhinagar from your factory?
items.a: About 430 km by road from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. We send equipment by road and install it through our own team or a local dealer in Gujarat. That makes it one of the nearer state capitals we deliver to.
